scenarios.name: gateway-critical-path-latency
scenarios.steadyStateProbe: p99 latency remains below 100ms and HTTP 5xx rate stays below 0.1%
scenarios.rollbackTrigger: p99 latency breaches 100ms for 3 consecutive minutes

scenarios.name: kafka-consumer-pod-kill
scenarios.steadyStateProbe: consumer lag recovers without lost messages
scenarios.rollbackTrigger: critical consumer lag alert fires or DLQ growth exceeds baseline

scenarios.name: postgres-dependency-errors
scenarios.steadyStateProbe: readiness gates reject failed dependencies and retries stay bounded
scenarios.rollbackTrigger: availability drops below 99.99% or error budget burn exceeds 2x
